content: Previous loops failed to find 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under controlled conditions. We now shift to gathering descriptive evidence on success rates and token usage for a single reproducible benchmark (BigBench). This allows us to map the performance landscape without waiting for controlled A/B tests that may not exist yet. We must strictly document where direct baseline comparisons are absent to maintain scientific rigor.
